name: Indiana Finally Returns 2023

venue.name: Herron-Riverside High School
venue.address: 3010 N White River Pkwy E Dr, Indianapolis, IN 46208

information:
The Midwest Cubing Association and The World Cube Association are pleased to welcome WCA Competitions back to the Hoosier State! 5x5 is featured as the main event of this competition, but there are still 3 rounds of 3x3. 

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). By registering, competitors agree to the information in the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianaFinallyReturns2023#24297-competitor-responsibilities) tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition. Not abiding by these responsibilities can result in disqualification. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndianaFinallyReturns2023#24300-health-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 information for this competition.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
